desc:
The same chocolatey peanut butter taste of Reese's Puffs now in itty bitty mini puffs

The perfect flavor combination of chocolate and peanut butter flavor, in mini size

Made with real REESE'S peanut butter for a breakfast cereal like no other

Mini breakfast cereal with no high fructose corn syrup

Contains one 11.7 oz box of General Mills Reese's Puffs Minis Chocolate Peanut Butter Breakfast Cereal
features:
Features

  • Classic chocolate and peanut butter flavor using real Reese’s peanut butter
  • Made with whole grain (approx. 15 g per serving)
  • No high-fructose corn syrup
  • Fortified with essential vitamins and minerals (iron, calcium, vitamin D, B-vitamins)
  • Kosher certified
  • Nutrition per 1-cup serving: 160 calories, 4.5 g total fat, 12 g sugar, 220 mg sodium, 3 g protein

Benefits

  • Provides whole grain goodness to support a balanced diet
  • Free from high-fructose corn syrup for a cleaner ingredient profile
  • Supports daily nutrient intake through vitamin and mineral fortification
  • Portion-controlled energy — helps manage calorie intake
  • Rich and indulgent taste of real Reese’s peanut butter and chocolate
  • Suitable for kosher diets
ingredients: Whole Grain Corn, Sugar, REESE'S Peanut Butter (peanuts, sugar, monoglycerides, peanut oil, salt, molasses, corn starch), Dextrose, Corn Meal, Corn Syrup, Canola and/or Sunflower Oil, Salt, HERSHEY'S Cocoa, Caramel Color, Trisodium Phosphate, Natural and Artificial Flavor, Rosemary Extract. Vitamin E (mixed tocopherols) Added to Preserve Freshness. Vitamins and Minerals: Tricalcium Phosphate, Calcium Carbonate, Vitamin C (sodium ascorbate), Iron and Zinc (mineral nutrients), A B Vitamin (niacinamide), Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine hydrochloride), Vitamin B1 (thiamin mononitrate), Vitamin A (palmitate), Vitamin B2 (riboflavin), A B Vitamin (folic acid), Vitamin B12, Vitamin D3.
